\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \kn{ಸಾಲ} \kn{ಕೊಡು}}
\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಲ} \kn{ಕೊಡು}} — \emph{sāla koḍu} — \textquotedblleft{}to lend (money)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಲ} \kn{ಕೊಡು}} (\emph{sāla koḍu}) is native Dravidian: \emph{sāla}, \textquotedblleft{}debt\textquotedblright{}, which DEDR 2472 lists, and \emph{koḍu}, \textquotedblleft{}to give\textquotedblright{} (DEDR 2053): \textquotedblleft{}to give a debt\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}
